lesson.title: Wonder as Sensorium
lesson.topic: Exploring how genuine curiosity and wonder can serve as a sensory feedback mechanism to understand complex systems better.
lesson.steelman: How can one use the concept of wonder to detect patterns in chaotic or uncertain environments?
lesson.example: A scientist using a sense of awe about nature to hypothesize new theories that later prove revolutionary in their field.

rationale: Adding this lesson enhances the curriculum's ability to foster critical thinking through curiosity and observation.
